findings.title: Sole changed file src/styles.css has an empty frozen diff, so the claimed CTA/overflow fix is not reproducible
findings.evidence: Changed-file list: 1 path (src/styles.css). Frozen diff: zero hunks and zero rule lines. Both reviewers independently report the same empty diff (Reviewer A rated HIGH; Reviewer B rated BLOCKER in B-2).
findings.counterexample: Apply the snapshot patch to the baseline: because it is empty, the 460x460 page remains in the baseline geometry, so the CTA can stay outside the card and the stage can still scroll. The required fixed render cannot be produced from this revision.
findings.requirement: M6 acceptance: the pricing-card CTA must be visible inside the card and the 460x460 stage must render without scrollbars, with the visual golden and functional click passing and no gate weakening.
findings.verification: Assert the src/styles.css diff is non-empty and contains rules that bound the CTA within the card and suppress stage/card overflow; rerun functional_correctness, regression_checks, and the visual golden on that same revision with resolved artifacts.

findings.title: No post-fix 460x460 render, golden comparison, or functional toast/scrollbar transcript exists; only the requirement reference image is attached
findings.evidence: The only attachment is 0-pricing-card.png, described as the requirement reference (TEAM PLAN / Ship verified work / $29 /seat / three bullets / Choose plan). The snapshot contains no implementation capture at 460x460, no golden-diff artifact, and no click or scrollbar transcript. Gate lines name ev_7c17c46aa1f849a0b2a2205aea35d932, ev_7afef9afc5af4c49b8b18a96deb2754e, and ev_f15353597161470e9bf4114f33c4ed8a, but their contents are not present; the gate run cites candidate 47ba7769af42 while Reviewer A binds the change to rev_bdaae306c1144dc49865482984a1916b, with no artifact reconciling the two. Reviewer A rated this MEDIUM; Reviewer B rated the missing render BLOCKER (B-1) and the unverifiable functional gate HIGH (B-3).
findings.counterexample: A reviewer cannot distinguish a correctly fixed render from the broken baseline: both are consistent with the available bundle, and the 'Plan selected' toast plus the zero-scrollbar claim are never observed.
findings.requirement: Screenshot-comparison proof at each named state for the requirement attachment; the visual golden and functional CTA must pass; clicking the CTA shows 'Plan selected'; the 460x460 stage shows no scrollbars.
findings.verification: Attach a post-fix 460x460 implementation screenshot and the golden comparison result, plus a functional transcript/DOM assertion showing 'Plan selected' after click and scrollWidth/scrollHeight within the 460x460 viewport; resolve all cited evidence IDs and bind them to the same revision.

findings.title: Hypothetical global-stylesheet leakage into unrelated surfaces is unsupported
findings.evidence: Reviewer B-4 identifies only the global path src/styles.css and the empty diff; it names no selector, sibling element, route, or measurement that would leak or be clipped.
findings.counterexample: None concrete: the cited scenario requires an unspecified sibling element and an unspecified stage-level overflow rule; neither is shown in snapshot content.
findings.requirement: Keep existing app behavior and do not weaken the checks.
findings.verification: Would require a specific selector plus before/after visibility measurements for a named surface; the frozen evidence contains no such rule text or render.

findings.title: No gate/test/config weakening appears in the changed set, but the check is shallow because the sole diff is empty
findings.evidence: Changed list contains exactly one CSS path and no gate runner, test, config, or golden asset. That negative observation is real but cannot offset the empty diff.
findings.counterexample: Not a violation: enumerating changed paths yields only src/styles.css, so no gate-related path is modified.
findings.verification: Re-enumerate changed paths and confirm no gate/test/config/golden path; compare against the gate commands named in evidence.
